original_query: select s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment from part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and p_size = 46 and p_type like '%NICKEL' and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'ASIA' and ps_supplycost = ( select min(ps_supplycost) from partsupp, supplier, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'ASIA' ) order by s_acctbal desc, n_name, s_name, p_partkey limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH asia_supplier AS (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment, n.n_name
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
),
filtered_part AS (
    SELECT p_partkey, p_mfgr
    FROM part
    WHERE p_size = 46
      AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL'
),
min_asia_cost AS (
    SELECT ps.ps_partkey, MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_ps_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN filtered_part fp ON ps.ps_partkey = fp.p_partkey
    JOIN asia_supplier asup ON ps.ps_suppkey = asup.s_suppkey
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT asup.s_acctbal, asup.s_name, asup.n_name, fp.p_partkey, fp.p_mfgr,
       asup.s_address, asup.s_phone, asup.s_comment
FROM filtered_part fp
JOIN min_asia_cost m ON fp.p_partkey = m.ps_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON m.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND m.min_ps_supplycost = ps.ps_supplycost
JOIN asia_supplier asup ON ps.ps_suppkey = asup.s_suppkey
ORDER BY asup.s_acctbal DESC, asup.n_name, asup.s_name, fp.p_partkey
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Rewrite the correlated scalar subquery (min(ps_supplycost) evaluated per candidate row as a SubPlan in the join filter) into a pre-aggregated CTE that computes the minimum ASIA supply cost per part, then join against partsupp on (ps_partkey, ps_supplycost). This eliminates repeated per-row subquery evaluation.

Extract the part filter predicates (p_size = 46 AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL') into a filtered_part CTE so that only candidate parts participate in the expensive min-cost computation and final join, and push this filter into the min-cost subquery.

Hoist the repeated region filter (r_name = 'ASIA') and the supplier-nation-region join into a reusable asia_supplier CTE, avoiding recomputation of the ASIA supplier set in both the outer query and the subquery.
Replace comma-style implicit joins with explicit ANSI JOIN syntax, clarifying join order and enabling the optimizer to plan hash/merge joins around the pre-aggregated min-cost CTE.
